location_name: Saint-Lô sector (corps on march from Brittany)
composing_units: 3rd Fallschirmjäger Division; 17th SS Panzergrenadier Division (assigned for blocking mission near Carentan)
notes: Meindl's corps diverted from Brittany toward Saint-Lô on 8 June; late on 9 June Rommel decided to commit it against the threat from Carentan/west.
